svg.text: 01. Timeline: mt_dev_create(), mtl_admin, inf->link_down & TX Flush / Teardown
Source: lib/src/mt_admin.c & lib/src/dev/mt_dev.c (15e2f411 vs c5f235c3). Time axis is non-linear: "//" marks a time cut; panels share aligned X events.
BEFORE (base 15e2f411) — CTRL.RST wipes timesync, 6 s blind admin loop, silent TX flush leak, unsafe mutex destroy
no cached link state per port
link drop invisible to tasklets & TX flush
Impact: E610 PTP clock stays dead after CTRL.RST; link down is unseen during flush; pad mbufs leak with false-clean return 0; uinit races alarm handler.
AFTER (PR #1951 HEAD c5f235c3) — Driver-aware timesync, 100 ms link poll + wake latch, bounded flush, drained cancel
updated every 100 ms (0 ns tasklet read)
or caps stall 64 ms, refunds pad
Outcome: E610 1588 clock stays enabled; link drop reaches tasklets in <=100 ms; flush fast-fails -EBUSY or caps stall at 64 ms (no leak); uinit drains alarm.
